name: Monthly repeat buyer keeper
why: Scores last month's repeat buying and picks one stage to fix, the same one-fix-a-month rhythm as the monthly-retention-fix workflow.

name: Subscription churn watcher
why: Tracks where subscribers cancel each month and whether last month's fix worked, as in the drop-out table of the retention-cohort-read skill.

name: Repeat order bottleneck finder
why: Finds the stage holding back second orders from an order export, a quick companion to the cohort read.

name: Reorder and second-order planner
why: Plans reorder messages from how long each product lasts, matching the reorder-timing-from-orders prompt.

name: Win-back flow builder
why: Builds a win-back flow timed to customers' own reorder gaps; keep any discount inside the margin room the client approves.

name: SMS send planner
why: Plans which events earn a text and tests how often to text, after the consent checks in the sms-consent-and-send-plan skill.

name: SMS send checker
why: Counts characters and flags problems in a text before it sends, alongside the text-message-pack-check prompt.

name: Subscription offer designer
why: Designs subscription discounts and plans from price and margin, the offer maths step of the subscription skill.

name: Subscription payback checker
why: Checks how long the business must wait to earn back a subscriber, the cash check before any launch.

name: Subscription cancel flow builder
why: Builds one save per cancel reason and a failed-payment plan; keep the cancel option on every screen, as this kit requires.

name: Cancel reason save planner
why: Matches each cancel reason to one fair save with screen copy, the same approach as the cancel-reason-read prompt.

name: Loyalty and VIP program designer
why: Costs loyalty perks per member and sets a test, in line with this kit's rule to test perks against a holdout before rolling out.

name: Email and SMS performance reader
why: Reads last month's email and text numbers for what to repeat; pair it with a holdout so attributed revenue is not taken as proof.

name: Plan a sale across email and SMS
why: Runs a full sale across email and texts, from text plan to results, like the sale-plan-email-and-sms prompt.
